messages:
mari (PM): Heads up — want to lock pass/fail guardrails for MVP vs v1 before next planning. Quick proposal: split criteria into 3 buckets: core UX, perf, and quality. Rough targets I’m thinking: p95 <= 300ms for v1, and a quality sanity check against our eval set. Thoughts?

dan (Eng): Agree on buckets. p95 300ms looks aggressive for MVP given current infra. Can we do p95 <= 400ms for MVP and keep 300ms as the v1 target?

liu (ML): Quality-wise: synthetic eval + production prompt set. Recommend: run both and add a manual review of 50 random samples from the prod prompts. Also add a regression guard: no >5% drop on top-line metric vs baseline.

michelle (Customer PM): Pilot customers are asking for a deterministic fallback when the model returns errors or hallucinations — that needs to be an MVP requirement (simple safe-fallback to fallback-template response).

ravi (Infra): If we accept 400ms for MVP, we should require auto-batching + KV prefix caching enabled and use quantization profile Q4 on staging. I’ll add infra tasks but we should make this explicit in the pass criteria so oncall knows to prioritize.

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary started for model-v1a on staging :rocket:

mari (PM): Thanks — this is helpful. Draft pass/fail language for doc: 

```
MVP pass if ALL of the following are met:
- Core flows (inference path, auth, retry/fallback) function end-to-end under nominal load
- p95 latency <= 400ms for text-gen on our staging workload
- Deterministic fallback in place for model errors/hallucinations
- No critical regressions vs baseline (>5% drop triggers fail)
\nv1 pass if ALL of the following are met:
- p95 latency <= 300ms under target production load
- 0 critical open bugs for 48h
- Quality metrics within 5% of baseline on production prompt set + manual QA signoff
```
\nIf no objections I’ll add this to the spec and link it in the milestone tracker. Ping here if you want edits. :slightly_smiling_face:

dan (Eng): :thumbsup: I’ll book a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize the exact cut decisions and owners.

liu (ML): One ask — can we enumerate the "core flows" in the doc? I’ll add my prod prompt subset there so evals are reproducible.

mari (PM): Good call, will add a short checklist for core flows (auth, create-request, streaming, fallback, metrics). Will post updated doc in this thread by EOD.
